issues.sym: The car will not start or go into Ready mode, the dash lights flash, or it needs a jump after sitting, sometimes after only a short stop. There is usually no warning beforehand.
issues.why: Owners report the small 12-volt battery going flat, sometimes on nearly new cars. One dealer blamed a software update that kept the car awake and drained the battery; Lexus also has a bulletin on 12-volt batteries losing charge when cars sit.
issues.next: Have the battery load-tested and ask the dealer about software updates. If the car sits for long periods, use a battery maintainer. Keep a jump pack handy.

issues.t: Fuel pump can fail and stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: The engine runs rough, will not start, shows a check engine light, or stalls while driving.
issues.why: The low-pressure fuel pump in the tank can fail. Lexus also issued a bulletin for hard starts and lean codes from weak fuel pumps on the 2019 UX 200.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 20V-682 at nhtsa.gov or with a Lexus dealer and have the free repair done if it is open. If the engine stalls, get off the road safely and have it towed.

issues.sym: Brake and stability control warnings, a harder brake pedal, or stability control switching off.
issues.why: On some 2019 UX 250h models the brake booster pump may fail, removing brake assist and stability control.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 19V-544 at nhtsa.gov or with a Lexus dealer and have the free repair done if it is open. Leave extra stopping distance until it is checked.

issues.t: Hybrid warning light or hard start in freezing weather
issues.sym: In temperatures below freezing the hybrid system warning light comes on, or the car is slow or hard to get into Ready mode.
issues.why: Lexus bulletins cover 2019-2020 UX 250h models that may be hard to start below 32 F and 2018-2024 Lexus hybrids that can show a hybrid warning in freezing weather.
issues.next: Note the temperature when it happens and have a Lexus dealer check for the related bulletin and software update.

issues.sym: A check engine light with a Hybrid System Malfunction message, and the car may lose power.
issues.why: Lexus bulletin L-SB-0006-20 covers 2019-2020 UX 250h models that set overcurrent codes between the motor generators and the inverter.
issues.next: Have the car checked by a Lexus dealer soon. Hybrid parts carry a long factory warranty, so ask about coverage.

issues.t: Hybrid System Overheated, Reduced Output Power message
issues.sym: A dash message that the hybrid system is overheated and power is reduced.
issues.why: Lexus bulletin LSB001122 covers 2022 UX 250h models that store a generator inverter high-temperature code and gives dealers a repair procedure.
issues.next: Pull over when safe and let the system cool. Have a dealer check for the bulletin; it is normally a warranty repair.

issues.t: Musty smell from the air conditioning
issues.sym: A musty or sour smell from the vents, especially when you first turn on the A/C.
issues.why: Moisture and mold build up on the A/C evaporator. Lexus issued bulletins with a cleaning procedure for 2019-2020 UX models.
issues.next: Replace the cabin air filter and ask the dealer about the A/C foam cleaning service. Running the fan without A/C for a few minutes before parking helps dry the system.

issues.t: SOS button, Bluetooth or right speaker not working
issues.sym: The SOS light is out, Bluetooth or voice commands do not work, the right front speaker is silent, or connected services stop working.
issues.why: Some 2019 UX models with a certain communication module have this fault, covered by Lexus bulletin L-SB-0032-20.
issues.next: Have a Lexus dealer check the communication module under the bulletin.

issues.t: Audio delays and XM No Signal messages
issues.sym: The audio is slow to mute, satellite radio shows No Signal, or voice recognition misbehaves.
issues.why: Lexus bulletin L-SB-0021-19 covers a software problem in the Pioneer audio system.
issues.next: Ask a Lexus dealer for the audio software update.

issues.t: Check engine light from the fuel pressure sensor
issues.sym: A check engine light with a fuel rail pressure sensor code, often with no change in how the car drives.
issues.why: Lexus bulletin LSB001222 says the engine computer logic was changed to fix this code on 2019 UX 250h models.
issues.next: Have the code read and ask the dealer about the engine computer update.

issues.t: Engine Maintenance Required message shows by mistake
issues.sym: An Engine Maintenance Required message appears even though service is not due.
issues.why: Lexus bulletin L-SB-0051-24 covers this message and its code on certain engines, including the UX 200.
issues.next: Confirm your service history, then ask a Lexus dealer to apply the bulletin fix.

issues.sym: A loud bang and broken glass falling from the sunroof while driving, with nothing hitting it.
issues.why: Owners of 2019 and 2024 UX models have reported the sunroof glass breaking on its own.
issues.next: Pull over safely, cover the opening, and have the glass replaced. File a report with Lexus and NHTSA.

issues.sym: A TPMS malfunction message and no tire pressures shown in the display.
issues.why: On at least one new 2022 UX 250h the tire pressure system was not programmed correctly at delivery.
issues.next: Check the tires with a gauge, then have the dealer register the sensors.

issues.t: Front tire tread chunking or peeling
issues.sym: Chunks of tread missing or peeling on the front tires, sometimes at low mileage.
issues.why: Owners of 2021 UX models report front tire tread breaking up. Alignment problems can contribute.
issues.next: Inspect the tires now and have the alignment checked. Contact the tire maker about warranty coverage.

issues.t: Pre-collision braking did not warn or brake
issues.sym: The forward collision warning or automatic braking did not react to a car or object ahead.
issues.why: Several owners have reported the pre-collision system not warning or braking before a crash. The system has limits, and dirty or misaligned sensors make it less reliable.
issues.next: Keep the windshield and front grille sensor area clean, and have the dealer check sensor calibration after any windshield or front-end repair. Never rely on it in place of your own braking.

issues.t: Wiring harness can break and cut drive power (recall)
issues.sym: Hybrid warnings and a sudden loss of drive power.
issues.why: Wires that feed the motor generator control unit in the engine room harness can break apart.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 24V-587 at nhtsa.gov or with a Lexus dealer and have the free repair done if it is open. The fix is a new harness.

issues.t: Instrument panel may not show warnings (recall)
issues.sym: Parts of the 12.3-inch driver display stay blank, so warnings for oil pressure, engine temperature or charging may not show.
issues.why: A software fault in the instrument cluster can leave sections of the display blank after startup.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 26V-341 at nhtsa.gov or with a Lexus dealer and have the free repair done if it is open. The fix is a software update.
